en: The image depicts a large, ornate building with distinctive architectural features, including steep, pointed roofs and decorative facades. There is a spired church on the left side of the image, and the foreground shows a busy street corner with people walking and a small kiosk. The overall style is reminiscent of early 20th-century Central European architecture. The photo is sepia-toned, suggesting it is from the early 1900s. The sign on the kiosk reads 'Péhndházi Szövetkezet,' which is Hungarian.
